exposure: Time between first nutrition and blood glucose measurement
cohort: The study included 207 newborn infants identified as being at risk for hypoglycemia, categorized into four groups: infants of diabetic mothers (IDM), large-for-gestational-age (LGA) infants, small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants, and late preterm infants (LPI).
finding: The highest incidence of hypoglycemia in the early postnatal period was observed in late preterm infants (34%), and lower gestational age was significantly associated with a higher incidence of hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: Delivery method was not found to be associated with hypoglycemia.
